slot.brief: What happens when diborane reacts with water/CO/O2 or Lewis bases like NH3 at different temperatures; identify products (e.g. B2H6 + 6H2O → 2H3BO3 + 6H2).

stem: On heating diborane with excess ammonia, borazine is formed. Which equation correctly represents this reaction?

verdicts.working: Borazine is B₃N₃H₆. Option A forms 2 molecules and balances B, N, and H: 3B₂H₆ + 6NH₃ → 2B₃N₃H₆ + 12H₂.

working:
$3\text{B}_2\text{H}_6+6\text{NH}_3\rightarrow2\text{B}_3\text{N}_3\text{H}_6+12\text{H}_2$
$\text{B}:6=6,\quad \text{N}:6=6,\quad \text{H}:36=12+24$

Independent check: Borazine is B₃N₃H₆. Option A forms 2 molecules and balances B, N, and H: 3B₂H₆ + 6NH₃ → 2B₃N₃H₆ + 12H₂.
solution:
Borazine has the formula $\text{B}_3\text{N}_3\text{H}_6$. Balancing atoms gives
$$3\text{B}_2\text{H}_6+6\text{NH}_3\rightarrow2\text{B}_3\text{N}_3\text{H}_6+12\text{H}_2$$
